subject: Operational visibility handoff — Everleaf Health dashboards & runbook alignment
messages:
From: Sam Wiley <sam.wiley@everleafhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood onboarding: observability scope for Everleaf Health

Hi Marissa and Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the performance profiles and the latency cost breakdown. As we move toward a pilot, I want to capture the observability scope so the implementation team can size dashboards and runbooks. Quick notes from my side: 

- Primary goals: API SLA tracking (99.9% p95), tracing for cross-service request flows, and error taxonomy for billing vs. user-impacting failures.
- Data retention: logs to be retained 90 days for compliance, traces 30 days.
- We need a dashboard for per-route latency, token spend per session, and error-rate by model variant.
- Point of contact for implementation: Priya Kumar (engineering manager).

Attaching the MVP metrics and a rough system diagram. Can your team propose a 3-week onboarding plan and an initial runbook template we can review?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Wiley
Director, Platform Engineering
Everleaf Health

Attachments: Everleaf_MVP_metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wiley <sam.wiley@everleafhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: observability scope for Everleaf Health

Sam — great summary, thanks. Naomi will own the CS-level handoff and schedule the kickoff; Laura will run instrumentation and dashboard work, Ben will cover tracing and SLOs. Proposed timeline (high level):

1) Week 0 (kickoff): alignment on objectives, access, and sample data.
2) Week 1: tracing hooks + KV cache validation; initial dashboards scaffold.
3) Week 2: alert routing, error taxonomy, and runbook draft.
4) Week 3: golden signals verification and handover.

I attached a lightweight telemetry matrix we use to map signals to dashboards/alerts. Naomi — can you take point on dates?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: telemetry_matrix.csv (csv)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wiley <sam.wiley@everleafhealth.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@everleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-04T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Operational visibility handoff & kickoff agenda — proposed times

Hi Sam / Priya — looping in the implementation leads. Thanks for the clear goals. Proposed kickoff: Thursday, March 9, 2028 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45 min). Agenda:

- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Access & sample payloads (5m)
- Instrumentation plan: traces, logs, metrics (10m)
- Dashboards & alerting priorities (10m)
- Next steps and owners (5m)

Pre-reads: telemetry_matrix.csv and Everleaf_MVP_metrics.xlsx (attached). I also created a shared Drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Everleaf-Onboarding

Action items for kickoff:
- Everleaf: share a sanitized request/response sample and SSO user that we can use for test traffic.
- Redwood: draft runbook template and a suggested alert routing map.

If Thursday doesn't work, propose two alternative slots and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@everleafhealth.com>, Sam Wiley <sam.wiley@everleafhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational visibility handoff & kickoff agenda — tracing + sampling questions

Hi Priya / Sam — a couple of technical questions to prepare: 

- Tracing: do you currently propagate a request-id header across services? If not, we recommend adding a single hop header that we can map to Redwood's span IDs.
- Sampling: what's your baseline traffic? For production we typically start at 10% adaptive sampling for full traces and 100% for error traces. Will that capture enough correlated data for your workflows?
- Retention: logs 90 days is fine; traces 30 days is OK but we should identify any regulatory traces that need longer retention.

I've attached an implementation checklist and a small telemetry matrix showing trace vs. metric linkage. Also, can you provide the names of the users who should receive pager and email alerts (we'll map to Slack later)?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: implementation_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Sam Wiley <sam.wiley@everleafhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@everleafhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-06T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational visibility handoff & kickoff agenda — tracing + sampling questions

On Tue, Mar 5, 2028 at 08:20 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Priya / Sam — a couple of technical questions to prepare: 
> 
> - Tracing: do you currently propagate a request-id header across services? If not, we recommend adding a single hop header that we can map to Redwood's span IDs.
> - Sampling: what's your baseline traffic? For production we typically start at 10% adaptive sampling for full traces and 100% for error traces. Will that capture enough correlated data for your workflows?
> - Retention: logs 90 days is fine; traces 30 days is OK but we should identify any regulatory traces that need longer retention.
> 
> I've attached an implementation checklist and a small telemetry matrix showing trace vs. metric linkage. Also, can you provide the names of the users who should receive pager and email alerts (we'll map to Slack later)?

Thanks Ben — we do propagate a request-id header across most services, though a couple legacy endpoints still need the header added. Baseline traffic: ~600 reqs/minute to the inference gateway during peak; 10% sampling sounds fine. We will confirm regulatory trace retention and share the list of on-call recipients.

I've uploaded a first-pass runbook draft to the shared Drive: runbook_draft.docx. That includes our incident examples and expected MTTR targets.

—Sam
Sam Wiley
Director, Platform Engineering
Everleaf Health

Attachments: runbook_draft.docx (document)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-08T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final prep & kickoff confirmation — Everleaf observability kickoff (Mar 9)

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Thu Mar 9 at 10:00 AM PT. Quick summary of agreed pre-kickoff deliverables: 

- Everleaf (Sam / Priya): provide sanitized request/response sample, list of on-call recipients for pager/email, and any regulatory traces requiring >30d retention (due Wed Mar 8 EOD).
- Redwood (Naomi / Laura / Ben): draft runbook template, initial dashboard wireframes, and alert routing diagram (shared Drive).

I've attached the three artifacts we'll iterate on during Week 1: telemetry_matrix.csv, runbook_draft.docx (the Everleaf file moved to Drive), and implementation_checklist.pdf. Please add comments in the Drive folder before kickoff if possible.

Next steps after kickoff: schedule a 90-minute instrumentation working session (Week 1) and plan a follow-up demo of dashboards (end of Week 2).

If anything changes with access or the sample data, ping me directly. Looking forward to getting this live.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: telemetry_matrix.csv, runbook_draft.docx, implementation_checklist.pdf
